approach.description: The single central narrative axis autonomously selected from the current case evidence.

rationale.description: Why that axis, evidence selection, compression, rhythm, reveal and required affective final movement fit this case.

choice.description: The model-selected case-specific hook form in its own words, not a fixed taxonomy.

rationale.description: Why the opening directly collides a verified ordinary role, relationship, situation or protection/trust expectation with the verified action or risk that breaks it.

openingText.description: The exact first one or two narration sentences, preserved for deterministic opening validation.

impactText.description: An exact openingText span carrying the highest-impact verified current-case fact or action.

impactMechanism.description: A free-form explanation of why the selected verified detail creates immediate case-specific impact without exaggeration.

expectationText.description: An exact openingText span expressing the verified ordinary role, relationship, situation or protection/trust expectation.

breachText.description: An exact openingText span expressing the verified concrete action or risk that breaks the expectation.

withheldQuestion.description: The single evidence-supported cause, process or result question left for later; it need not appear as a spoken question.

retentionGap.description: A free-form audit explanation of the evidence-supported cause, escalation or result gap left after the concrete opening.

payoff.description: An exact later narration span that accurately answers the withheld question without harming chronological clarity.

approach.description: The model-selected way the narration embeds the listener inside this case's verified physical sequence, without a fixed scene template.

continuityRationale.description: How verified spatial, audible or action cues let an audio-only listener follow changes and continuity.

text.description: An exact narration span carrying a verified physical cue or linked action.

continuityRole.description: A free-form account of how this span advances spatial, audible, action or temporal continuity; not a fixed taxonomy.

attributionStrategy.description: How legally necessary attribution remains accurate through a clearly responsible named source or evidence object, while reportorial production meta and subjectless passive attribution are excluded.

text.description: An exact narration attribution span that identifies the responsible source, record or evidence object.

necessity.description: Why attribution or qualification is necessary for these current-case claims.

dominantAftertaste.description: The model-selected case-specific emotional aftertaste in free text, with no fixed taxonomy.

codaRationale.description: Why this coda follows from current-case evidence and avoids a reusable stock ending.
